mapper.select: /* main.selectDocCount */ SELECT * FROM lab_doc_count_view WHERE DOC_OWNER = #{userId}
/* main.getDocStatusCount */ SELECT * FROM lab_doc_status_view WHERE DOC_OWNER = #{userId}
/* main.getApprStatusCount */ SELECT * FROM lab_appr_status_view WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

/* main.selectTeamDocCount */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(PROD_CNT), 0) AS PROD_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(MENU_CNT), 0) AS MENU_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(DESIGN_CNT), 0) AS DESIGN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(SENSE_QUALITY_CNT), 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(PLAN_CNT), 0) AS PLAN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(TRIP_CNT), 0) AS TRIP_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(RESEARCH_CNT), 0) AS RESEARCH_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(RESULT_CNT), 0) AS RESULT_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(CHEMICAL_CNT), 0) AS CHEMICAL_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(PACKAGE_CNT), 0) AS PACKAGE_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(RECIPE_CNT), 0) AS RECIPE_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(ETC_CNT), 0) AS ETC_CNT FROM lab_doc_count_view WHERE DOC_OWNER IN ( SELECT USER_ID FROM lab_user WHERE ORGAID = #{ORGAID} AND EMSTAT = '1' )

/* main.selectDocCountByTeam : 임원용 팀별 파이 */ SELECT U.ORGAID, MAX(H.OBJTTX) AS TEAM_NAME, IFNULL(SUM(V.PROD_CNT), 0) AS PROD_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.MENU_CNT), 0) AS MENU_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.DESIGN_CNT), 0) AS DESIGN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.SENSE_QUALITY_CNT), 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.PLAN_CNT), 0) AS PLAN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.TRIP_CNT), 0) AS TRIP_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.RESEARCH_CNT), 0) AS RESEARCH_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.RESULT_CNT), 0) AS RESULT_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.CHEMICAL_CNT), 0) AS CHEMICAL_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.PACKAGE_CNT), 0) AS PACKAGE_CNT FROM lab_user U LEFT JOIN lab_interface_hr1010 H ON H.OBJTID = U.ORGAID LEFT JOIN lab_doc_count_view V ON V.DOC_OWNER = U.USER_ID WHERE U.EMSTAT = '1'
GROUP BY U.ORGAID ORDER BY TEAM_NAME
/* main.selectExecTeams : 임원용 팀 목록(사용중 팀만) */ SELECT ORGAID, TEAM_NAME FROM lab_used_team_view ORDER BY TEAM_NAME

/* main.selectExecAllDocCount : 임원용 전체(모든 팀) 파이 */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(V.PROD_CNT), 0) AS PROD_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.MENU_CNT), 0) AS MENU_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.DESIGN_CNT), 0) AS DESIGN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.SENSE_QUALITY_CNT), 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.PLAN_CNT), 0) AS PLAN_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.TRIP_CNT), 0) AS TRIP_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.RESEARCH_CNT), 0) AS RESEARCH_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.RESULT_CNT), 0) AS RESULT_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.CHEMICAL_CNT), 0) AS CHEMICAL_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.PACKAGE_CNT), 0) AS PACKAGE_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.RECIPE_CNT), 0) AS RECIPE_CNT, IFNULL(SUM(V.ETC_CNT), 0) AS ETC_CNT FROM lab_user U JOIN lab_used_team_view T ON T.ORGAID = U.ORGAID LEFT JOIN lab_doc_count_view V ON V.DOC_OWNER = U.USER_ID WHERE U.EMSTAT = '1'

/* main.getExecAllTeamDocStatusCount : 임원용 전체 팀원 상태(모든 팀) */ SELECT U.ORGAID, T.TEAM_NAME, U.USER_NAME, U.USER_ID AS DOC_OWNER,
IFNULL(V.PROD_REG_CNT, 0) AS PROD_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.PROD_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PROD_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PROD_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PROD_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PROD_COMP_CNT, 0) AS PROD_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PROD_TMP_CNT, 0) AS PROD_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PROD_RET_CNT, 0) AS PROD_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.MENU_REG_CNT, 0) AS MENU_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.MENU_APPR_CNT, 0) AS MENU_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.MENU_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS MENU_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.MENU_COMP_CNT, 0) AS MENU_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.MENU_TMP_CNT, 0) AS MENU_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.MENU_RET_CNT, 0) AS MENU_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.DESIGN_REG_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.DESIGN_APPR_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.DESIGN_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.DESIGN_COMP_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.DESIGN_TMP_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.DESIGN_RET_CNT, 0) AS DESIGN_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_REG_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_APPR_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_COMP_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_TMP_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.SENSE_QUALITY_RET_CNT, 0) AS SENSE_QUALITY_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.PLAN_REG_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.PLAN_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PLAN_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PLAN_COMP_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PLAN_TMP_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PLAN_RET_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.TRIP_REG_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.TRIP_APPR_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.TRIP_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.TRIP_COMP_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.TRIP_TMP_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.TRIP_RET_CNT, 0) AS TRIP_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_REG_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_APPR_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_COMP_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_TMP_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESEARCH_RET_CNT, 0) AS RESEARCH_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.RESULT_REG_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESULT_APPR_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESULT_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESULT_COMP_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESULT_TMP_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.RESULT_RET_CNT, 0) AS RESULT_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_REG_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_APPR_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_COMP_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_TMP_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.CHEMICAL_RET_CNT, 0) AS CHEMICAL_RET_CNT,
IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_REG_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_REG_CNT, IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_COND_APPR_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_COND_APPR_CNT, IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_COMP_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_COMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_TMP_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_TMP_CNT, IFNULL(V.PACKAGE_RET_CNT, 0) AS PACKAGE_RET_CNT
FROM lab_user U JOIN lab_used_team_view T ON T.ORGAID = U.ORGAID LEFT JOIN lab_doc_status_view V ON U.USER_ID = V.DOC_OWNER WHERE U.EMSTAT = '1' ORDER BY T.TEAM_NAME, U.USER_NAME
